name: Voldo
source:
An alchemist who suddenly appeared in Thracia several years ago. He has achieved great success with his despicable operations, such as mixing poison in river water and using animals as bombs. 

He has risen through the ranks to become the kingdom's official alchemist and has succeeded in gaining the position of chief of staff for this ongoing expedition.

[Translated from [url=http://amatures.ohimesama.net/ingoku/]Official site[/url]]
